name: Kuro
source:
Kuro is a cat whom lives with the protagonist. He is a telepath, which allows him to communicate with other ESP users. One other aspect which sets him apart from a normal cat, is the fact that he has lived for several hundred years.

Roughly edited from a Google Translation of the following website: [url=https://ja.wikipedia.org/wiki/未来ノスタルジア]Japanese Wikipedia[/url]
